issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: vine, moss_carpet, stone_brick_wall, red_banner.

notes.artefacts: the wall torch at (1,6,1) facing south hangs on the red banner at (1,6,0); a banner can't hold a torch, so in game it pops off when placed
notes.life: Vines under the corbels on both faces, moss carpet on the walk.
notes.detail: For a 3x3 module, banner + lantern + vines + moss is a good amount.

visual.summary: L2 plus vines hanging under the corbels on both outer faces and moss carpet on the walk; the most lived-in version.
problems: Wall torch at (1,6,1) [facing=south] is unsupported (north neighbour (1,6,0) is the banner): attach it to a merlon, e.g. at (2,6,1) facing south against merlon (2,6,0).
Lantern post at (2,5,2)/(2,6,2) still narrows the corner walk to 1 block.

Open ends match the straight profile (footing stair y0, wall z1-2/x1-2, corbel stair y4, parapet y5, walk standing at y5, merlons at even positions), so it joins cleanly. Note for the whole wall set, not this piece: odd-length modules with merlons at both ends put two merlons side by side at every joint (corner x2 next to straight x0, same as straight x4 next to straight x0).
